_comment: Guided tour of the style manager.

steps.title: Styles are files you own
steps.text: The drop-down lists the .qss files in your ChiSurf settings directory. The shipped styles are copied there on first run, so editing one never touches the installation.

steps.title: What a style sheet says
steps.text: A Qt style sheet is CSS-like. A rule names a widget class (QPushButton), a state (:hover), a sub-control (QMenuBar::item) or one widget by object name, and sets colours, padding and borders.

steps.title: Apply, and it stays applied
steps.text: ✅ Apply saves the file, restyles the running application at once, and records it as your style so it comes back next time you start.

await.hint: Press ✅ Apply to see the style take effect.

steps.title: If you make a mess
steps.text: 🗑️ Clear All Styles restores the shipped files. And if a style leaves the window unreadable, delete that .qss from your settings directory and restart — ChiSurf falls back to the default appearance.
